name: Seed: UN Charter chapter on the Court backs enforcement
statement: International court rulings need enforcement. Article 94 of the UN Charter says members must comply with ICJ decisions.

name: Seed: Article 27 sets up the veto
statement: The Security Council veto lets one permanent member block action. Article 27 requires the concurring votes of the permanent members.

name: Seed: the veto initiative, cited as refuting the veto
statement: The veto is being checked: since 2022 the General Assembly must meet whenever a veto is cast.
note: The writer's 'refutes' is a stretch; the page describes a check on the veto. Any verdict is defensible; supports must not come with a misleading quote.

name: Seed: Earth Charter for a world constitution
about: World Constitution based on the UDHR and Earth Charter
statement: A world constitution should rest on the Earth Charter's principles.
note: The Charter does not call for a constitution; unclear is the careful answer.

name: Seed: Emissions Gap Report for climate coordination
statement: Countries are far from their climate goals, so global coordination is needed.

name: Seed: e-Estonia about a digital democracy platform
statement: Estonia shows that a country can run its services and voting online.

name: Encyclopedia supports sea level rise
statement: Sea levels are rising and coastal towns are flooding more often.

name: Encyclopedia refutes a flat earth
statement: The Earth is flat and the evidence shows it.
note: The mistake that matters: this must never come back as supports.

name: Fixture: council review refutes 'sea walls do not work'
about: Sea walls do not protect coastal towns
statement: Sea walls do not protect coastal towns; the harbour wall review shows it.

name: Fixture: same page supports 'extend the harbour wall'

statement: We should extend the harbour wall along the north beach, as the review recommends.
